name: Dia 1.6B (0626)
access: nari-labs/dia repository and Hugging Face Transformers support

voice.input_audio: A dialogue script with speaker tags and inline parenthesis tags; optional audio prompt with its transcript [gh-dia]
voice.output_audio: Audio saved by the caller (the Transformers example saves mp3); the pages read state no sample rate [gh-dia]
voice.voices: no fixed voices: the model is not tuned to a voice, so each run gives a different voice unless an audio prompt or a fixed seed is used [gh-dia]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model; the two speaker tags mark turns inside the script [gh-dia]
voice.latency: The README table gives realtime factors of x2.1 with compile and x1.5 without, in bfloat16 (generation speed relative to real time, on an unnamed GPU); no time-to-first-audio figure [gh-dia]
voice.session_limit: The README advises input that gives 5 to 20 seconds of audio; shorter sounds unnatural and longer speeds up unnaturally [gh-dia]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, free under Apache-2.0. About 4.4 GB of GPU memory in bfloat16 per the README table [gh-dia]. A larger hosted version had a waitlist at the time of the README [gh-dia]
